tagline: Global Leader in Outsourced Semiconductor Packaging and Test Services
hero_kpi_rationale: Amkor positions itself as a leader in advanced semiconductor packaging and test solutions, particularly for high-growth markets such as AI, high-performance computing (HPC), automotive, and data centers. These markets are key drivers of demand for higher-performance chips and innovative packaging solutions.

kpis.name: AI / HPC / Automotive Demand
kpis.explanation: Demand for semiconductor packaging and test services in the artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, automotive, and data center sectors.
kpis.description: Represents consolidated net sales, reflecting overall demand for Amkor's services in advanced applications.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by key technology markets.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin indicates profitability of core operations before operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Margin under pressure due to startup and operating costs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating costs.
kpis.description: Operating margin measures profitability of the company's core business activities.
kpis.signal: Slight improvement despite gross margin pressures.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in physical assets to support future growth.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are crucial for capacity expansion and technological development. In 2025, investments reached 13.5% of net sales.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment in a new facility in Arizona and advanced equipment.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue dedicated to research and development of new technologies.
kpis.description: R&D spending is essential to maintain a competitive edge in the technology sector. In 2025, R&D represents 2.5% of revenue.
kpis.signal: Ongoing commitment to innovation for advanced markets.

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Available cash and assets easily convertible into cash.
kpis.description: Cash and cash equivalents are essential for financial flexibility and risk management.
kpis.signal: Strong liquidity position to fund operations and investments.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €1.56 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €1.38 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Vietnam Facility Ramp-Up
kpis.explanation: Initial high-volume production phase at the new Vietnam facility, opened in 2024, impacting margins in 2025.
kpis.description: The startup of a new facility impacts costs and short-term profitability, but is essential for future growth. Production at the Vietnam Facility is in the initial high-volume manufacturing phase.
kpis.signal: Negative impact on gross margin in 2025, indicator of capacity ramp-up.

kpis.name: Arizona Facility Construction
kpis.explanation: Commencement of construction of a new U.S. facility in the second half of 2025 to support supply chain regionalization.
kpis.description: This investment aims to enhance capacity to serve customers seeking to regionalize their supply chains and participate in U.S. semiconductor initiatives. Construction began in the second half of 2025.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment to strengthen U.S. presence and respond to local initiatives.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Total dividend paid per share over the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance ex-div dates.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Dividends + cumulative buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income redistributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Industry Downturn
risks.summary: The company is vulnerable to declines in demand in the semiconductor industry, which can significantly affect its operating results and cash flows.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in the semiconductor market, which can have a significant impact on its operating results. The cyclical nature of the semiconductor industry creates substantial risks of revenue and profitability volatility. (Item 1A, Item 7) (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supplier Dependence
risks.summary: The company is exposed to supply chain disruption risks due to its reliance on a few key suppliers.
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on a limited number of suppliers for certain materials and components, which may create supply chain disruption risks. (Item 1A) (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: The company faces increased competition in the semiconductor packaging and test services market from established competitors and customers' internal capabilities.
risks.score_rationale: The company faces intensified competition in the semiconductor packaging and test services market, including from IDMs' internal capabilities and other competitors, which may affect its market share. (Item 1A) (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.summary: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, particularly due to its reliance on information systems and customers' sensitive data.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, particularly due to its reliance on information systems and sensitive data. (Item 1A) (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Price Fluctuations
risks.summary: The company is exposed to fluctuations in the prices of materials and components, which may affect its manufacturing costs and operating margins.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in the prices of materials and components, which may affect its costs and operating results. (Item 1A) (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Key Customer Dependence
risks.summary: The company is exposed to revenue loss risks if its key customers depart or reduce volume.
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on a few key customers, which may create revenue loss risks in the event of customer departures. (Item 1A) (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory and Trade Risks
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks related to changes in laws, regulations, and trade policies applicable to the semiconductor industry and international trade.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory risks and changes in trade policy, particularly due to new tariffs and trade restrictions. (Item 7 MD&A) (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Amkor positions itself as a leader in semiconductor packaging and test solutions for AI and high-performance computing applications. The company is actively developing advanced packaging technologies specifically targeted to support the growing demands of AI applications, particularly in high-performance computing and data center segments.
evidence: Comprehensive portfolio includes advanced packaging solutions targeting AI applications for data centers and high-performance computing
Collaborating with industry leaders in HPC and AI markets as key strategic end markets
Strong position in developing advanced technologies such as HDFO, 2.5D integration, and advanced flip chip for AI-related computing infrastructure
